title: CAFÉ M5 Solution RA — UAE Multi-Domain Early-Warning System
_comment_archetype: A4 (Multi-Agent Coordinator) is the primary archetype — multiple specialised agents collaborate (analyst, watch officer brief). A5 (Research/Analytic) provides the OSINT fusion + assessment loop. Both per CAFE_UAE_DataSource_Audit.md.
_comment_exclude: The PoC explicitly excludes Power Automate (no orchestration approvals — Telegram delivery is the only side-effect; HITL happens out-of-band) and Copilot Studio engine (no conversational agent; this is a standing watch).
_comment_custom_comps: Per §9.3 boundary-interfaces rule: the ingestion pipeline, the COP web app, and the Telegram delivery channel are TRADITIONAL architecture components, not catalogued in M4. They appear here marked kind=boundary and render with dashed borders.

_comment_edges: Solution-specific flows on top of the canonical A4+A5 composition. The OSINT pipeline feeds a Knowledge contract (G06 grounding via Foundry IQ); the LLM analyst (Foundry Agent Service) reads ontology-bound state (Fabric IQ) + raw retrievals, emits advisories that humans authorise; the COP renders the current picture.
_comment_guardrails: All standard M3 guardrails apply (G01-G10) per A4+A5. CAFÉ-AI guardrails G11/G12/G13 are critical for an early-warning system (no-false-comfort, anti-spoofing, corroboration). G14 (Agent 365 inventory) applies to the LLM analyst + any sub-agents.
decision_points: Corroboration ≥2 independent sources before high-confidence advisory (G13)
Single-source signals open only a low-confidence watch (G13)
Human authorises every advisory dispatch (G09; decision-support only — no autonomous action)
Absence/staleness of signal communicated as 'no indication yet', never 'all-clear' (G11)
Tier = imminence × severity → ranked action options; humans pick
